caption: The drawing shows a large, hexagonal lantern with a sloping roof that ends in a vented, tiered top and a small knob. The main lantern is painted in shades of green with dark red trim, and each vertical panel is separated by red outlines that run from the base to the roof. There are cut-out star shapes on three of the sloped sections. The lantern contains dark rectangular glass panels in each section, and red shading is used to create dimensionality and shadows. A long, flat brown handle is attached to one side by a round fastener. In the upper right corner, there is a line drawing depicting a side view of the lantern with an open panel and the handle visible. To the right of the lantern, three rectangular colored symbols are displayed in a vertical row; the top rectangle has the word "ONE" in white letters on a red background, the middle rectangle contains a white "1" on a dark background, and the bottom rectangle has a white "0" on a green background. The artist's signature appears at the bottom right corner of the image. The background of the drawing is a plain, beige color.
title: Lantern
